title: Declinarea responsabilității
content:
Declinarea responsabilității

Acest site web și produsele noastre sunt destinate exclusiv scopurilor de divertisment. We do not claim to be historians or experts in the events that surround our stories. While the main events in our stories are based on actual events in history, our characters, storylines, names, places and some dates are fictional. We thoughtfully research the historical events and eras our stories are based in to give them as much authenticity as possible. However, Scrisorile cu Flori are first and foremost works of historical fiction and intended for entertainment purposes. We do hope that our stories may inspire our readers to dig deeper and research in more depth the historical events that shape our world.
